annotations.title: Create a burofax draft for review

description: Use this when the user has approved the final text of a letter to send as a burofax to an address in Spain and has given both postal addresses. The user writes or approves the text; this service does not give legal advice, so pass the body exactly as approved, without adding legal claims. Show the full text to the user and get approval before calling. Renders the exact A4 letter (sender, recipient, place and date, subject, body, signature line) as a PDF in Spanish, stores it as a draft and returns the page count, the price of each option and a review_url. Nothing is sent and nothing is charged by this tool: after calling it, show the review_url and tell the user that the letter goes out only after they pay on that page. Never ask for or include DNI/NIE/NIF or other ID numbers. Do not use to check prices (use quote_burofax) or to track a paid letter (use get_burofax_status).

body.description: The full letter body exactly as the user approved it, in Spanish (or bilingual). Separate paragraphs with a blank line. No address blocks, date or signature: those are added automatically.

city.description: City for the dateline "En <city>, a <date>". Defaults to the sender's city.

option.description: Delivery option: "correos" (Burofax de Correos) or "notificados" (certified notification by a trusted third party, not Correos). Use the user's choice; if they have none, use "correos". They can switch on the review page.

recipient.description: Who receives it. Must be a postal address in Spain.

name.description: Full name of the person or company, as it should appear on the letter.

province.description: Province, optional. Checked against the postcode when given.

street.description: Street, number, floor and door, e.g. "Calle Mayor 12, 3º B".

sender.description: Who sends the letter. Printed top left and on the signature line.

country.description: Only if the sender lives outside Spain, e.g. "United Kingdom". Omit for Spain.

email.description: Sender's email for the receipt and tracking, optional. Not printed on the letter.

name.description: Full name of the person or company, as it should appear on the letter.

province.description: Province, optional. Checked against the postcode when given.

street.description: Street, number, floor and door, e.g. "Calle Mayor 12, 3º B".

subject.description: Short subject line, in Spanish, printed as "Asunto: …", e.g. "Reclamación de la fianza del contrato de alquiler".
